summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements and concerns in the industry. Anthropic's CEO discusses the crisis of trust in AI, while OpenAI introduces a new mode to speed up its model. Other notable stories include Google's update to remove visible watermarks and Meta's release of an open-weight AI model.
insight: The increasing use of AI in various industries has led to a growing need for transparency and accountability, with companies like Anthropic and OpenAI taking steps to address these concerns.
highlights: Anthropic's CEO discusses the crisis of trust in AI and the need for transparency
OpenAI introduces a new mode to speed up its model, making it more accessible to enterprise users
Google updates its AI tool to remove visible watermarks, giving users more control over their generated content
